features.title: Living on the edge
features.text: Daredevils leap into danger, using movement and maneuvers to set up attacks. A daring stunt can knock an enemy down or push them out of position.

features.title: Adrenaline
features.text: Starting a risky action grants adrenaline even if the roll fails. It powers special attacks until the start of the daredevil's next turn.

review.notes: Provisional assessment of the named playtest, not the final class. The public playtest period has ended; the published rules may differ.

ratings.offense: 4 → 3–4. Provisional playtest estimate: stunt and press choices trade setup and risk for follow-up attacks.
ratings.defense: 3 → 3. Movement and defensive features help, but risky actions can expose an eight-HP martial.
ratings.support: 3 → 2.5–3.5. Stunt maneuvers reposition or restrain foes; chosen feats determine the emphasis.
ratings.utility: 3 → 3. Athletics, Acrobatics and broad starting skills support physical exploration.
ratings.difficulty: 4 → 4. Risky actions, adrenaline timing and movement requirements create a demanding action sequence.
